headline: Anantam Highways Trust sponsor holding at 37.54%
summary: Anantam Highways Trust reports Q2FY27 unitholding. Sponsors hold 37.54%, while public holding stands at 62.46% with significant institutional participation.

headline: Dr. Reddy's FTO-9 facility gets Form 483 with 3 observations
summary: The USFDA completed a pre-approval inspection at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories' FTO-9 facility and issued a Form 483 with three observations.

headline: ICICI Lombard Q2 net profit up 15% YoY to 9.46b rupees
summary: ICICI Lombard General Insurance reported Q2 net profit of 9.46b rupees versus 8.2b rupees YoY, beating the estimate of 7.7b. Revenue rose to 66.5b rupees from 56.5b rupees YoY.

headline: Suyog Urja wins 100 MW wind power LOI worth ₹228 crore
summary: Enviro Infra Engineers' subsidiary Suyog Urja Limited has received a Letter of Intent for a 100 MW wind power project from Arie Energy LLP, valued at ₹228 crore.

headline: IDBI Bank rallies 9% on Fairfax deal; HDBFS slips on Q2 results
summary: IDBI Bank surges 8.98% after Govt approves Fairfax's ₹52,878 crore stake buy. HDB Financial Services drops 4.15% as Q2 net profit misses estimates despite 34% YoY growth.

headline: Koura Fine Diamond promoter acquires warrants
summary: Kamlesh Lodhiya acquired 3.5 lakh convertible warrants via preferential issue, increasing diluted holding to 64.39%.

headline: Ganon Products promoter sells 0.93% stake
summary: Kamla Business Ventures LLP sold 87,743 equity shares of Ganon Products Ltd via open market sale on October 14, 2026. Post-sale holding stands at 4.99%.

headline: Fairfax plans to resolve dual bank ownership with RBI
summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings has presented a plan to the Reserve Bank of India to address its shared ownership of IDBI Bank and CSB Bank.

headline: NTPC plans six nuclear reactors with Rosatom
summary: NTPC Ltd plans to build six nuclear reactors in partnership with Russia's Rosatom, with an expected project cost of ₹1.5 trillion.

headline: AXISCADES Tech's US unit Xida plans $7M asset buy
summary: AXISCADES Technologies' US division, Xida, plans to acquire assets of Itsj Group for a maximum of $7 million, marking a significant cross-border acquisition move.

headline: Nomura initiates Buy on Paytm, target ₹2,250
summary: Nomura initiates coverage on One 97 Communications (Paytm) with a Buy rating and target price of ₹2,250, forecasting a 96% EBITDA CAGR over FY26–29 at 26x FY29E EV/EBITDA.

headline: Jindal Stainless deploys electric trucks
summary: Jindal Stainless deploys 10 electric trucks for green mobility, targeting 71 tonnes monthly CO2 savings. The initiative integrates EVs with LNG and CNG fleets to decarbonise logistics.

headline: Rupee opens at 84.92 vs dollar, stronger than prior close
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 84.92 against the US dollar, firmer than the previous close of 85.15, reflecting a marginal strengthening in early trade.

headline: Mach Travel wins MP Tourism empanelment
summary: Mach Travel Solutions Limited has been empanelled by Madhya Pradesh Tourism Corporation for a 10,000-pilgrim Tirth Yatra programme, expanding its government travel footprint.

headline: Unijolly Investments appoints new CS and CO
summary: Unijolly Investments Company Limited appointed Durga Prasad Naidu as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 15, 2026. The appointment was approved by the Board of Directors in a meeting held on the same date.

headline: ESDS Software Solution block trade on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 1,74,589 shares of ESDS Software Solution was executed on the NSE at ₹1,591.60 per share, totalling ₹27.79 crore.

headline: Cupid shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 729,997 Cupid shares changing hands on NSE at ₹353.20, with a combined value of ₹25.78 crore.

headline: PB Fintech shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,99,175 PB Fintech shares changing hands on BSE at ₹1,056.30, with a combined value of ₹21.04 crore.

headline: Healthy Investments appoints Nanditha Nagaraj as CS
summary: Healthy Investments Limited appointed Mrs. Nanditha Nagaraj as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 15, 2026, following a board meeting.

headline: Paras Healthcare IPO: ₹375 Cr Issue; Debt Repayment Focus
summary: Paras Healthcare Limited files DRHP for a ₹375 crore IPO. Proceeds primarily target debt reduction. Revenue grew at 19.26% CAGR to ₹1,605.95 crore in FY2026.

headline: Motherson Sumi Wiring sees ₹59.07 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 17,151,519 shares of Motherson Sumi Wiring was executed on BSE for ₹59.07 crore at a price of ₹34.44 per share.

headline: LTM wins multi-million dollar AI services deal
summary: LTM Limited secures a multi-million dollar managed services transformation deal with a North American engineering firm to build an AI-led operating model.

headline: Bajaj Consumer Care targets double-digit growth
summary: Bajaj Consumer Care management emphasizes long-term double-digit growth goals. Almondrop brand sees strong volume rise, with distribution expansion adding 2-3%.

headline: IndiGrid sponsor holding at 1.11% in Q2FY27
summary: IndiGrid Infrastructure Trust reports sponsor group holding of 1.11% as on September 30, 2026. Public holding stands at 98.89% with FPIs at 23.92%.

headline: Dalmia Bharat Sugar sets up UAE subsidiary
summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries incorporated Dalmia Bharat Global Holdings Limited in Abu Dhabi on October 14, 2026, to manage foreign investments.
